page.overview:
Who is Aadil?

Aadil is a character seen in the episode "Mysterious Island". He lived on Back to Nature Island before he was presumably killed.

Aadil has poofy brown hair and doesn't wear a hat. He is seen wearing a dark pink outfit with a light pink collar.
